Kwe ka ngwa a tọọ mkpu ma nhazioge mmem nwere mmetụta oge. Ikwenye nke a nwere ike ịbawanye ojiji batịrị. Ọ bụrụ na anabataghị, ngwa a nwere ike ọ gaghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma, ma mkpu ya agaghị arụ ọrụ dịka ahazieoge.

%s nwere nweta ohere nchịkwa ngwaọrụ ma na-enweta ohere data mgbe niile dịka ebe gị, ozi ederede na akụkọ oku na ndabere. Ọ bụrụ na ị tụkwasịghị obi na ngwa a, a na-akwado iwepụ nweta ohere na nchịkwa ngwaọrụ.

Nchedo ngwa a chọtara na ngwa malware na ekwentị gị. Ngwa malware nwere ike izu ohi data nkeonwe gị, gosi mgbasa ozi maọbụ kpata ọgba aghara ndị ọzọ. Iji chekwaa ekwentị gị na data gị, gaa na Nchedo ngwa ka ị wepụ ngwa ahụ.
Nchedo ngwa na-enyocha ngwa gị mgbe niile maka malware na omume ọjọọ ndị ọzọ, wee zitere gị ozi ma ọ bụrụ na achọpụtara nsogbu ọbụla. Gbanye Nchedo ngwa maka nchekwa ekwentị na data gị.
%s nwetara ndịnzikọrịtaozi n’agbanghi na i mepebeghi ngwa ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị chọghị ka ngwa a nweta ndịnzikọrịtaozi gị, jụ inye ikike inweta ndịnzikọrịtaozi.

Ihe karịrị 1 afọ agafeela kemgbe mmelite ngwaọrụ ikpeazụ. Itinye mmelite na-ahụ na ekwentị gị na-enwe nchebe kachasị ọhụrụ mgbe niile.
Aro na ọkwa ga-apụta ebe a iji nyere gị aka idobe ekwentị gị na data nkeonwe gị nke ọma.

Google Play Protect chọtara ngwa malware na ekwentị gị. Ngwa malware nwere ike izu ohi data nkeonwe gị, gosi mgbasa ozi maọbụ kpata ọgba aghara ndị ọzọ. Iji chekwaa ekwentị gị na data gị, soro ntuziaka dị na Google Play Protect ka ị wepụ ngwa ahụ.
Ihe karịrị 1 afọ agafeela kemgbe mmelite ngwaọrụ ikpeazụ Google Play systemụ. Itinye mmelite na-ahụ na ekwentị gị na-enwe nchebe kachasị ọhụrụ mgbe niile.
Ebe mgbaama nchekwa na nzuzo na-enye aro na mgbaama iji nyere gị aka idobe ekwentị na data nkeonwe gị nke ọma.
"A ga-enye gị ozi mgbe ngwa na-eji ikike ịnweta data nkeonwe gị kwa ugboro maọbụ n'azụ. A ga-enye gị ohere inyocha ikike wee kpebie ma ị chọrọ ịga n'ihu na-ahapụ ha."
"A na-enye ozi nzuzo dabere na ka ngwa si jiri data gị n'ime awa 24 gara aga ma enwere ike igosi ya ọbụlagodi na ị jụrụ ikike na nso a."

A ga-ezitere gị ozi mgbe achọpụtara ihe iyi egwu nchekwa na ekwentị gị. Nke a nwere ike ịgụnye ngwa malware nke kwesịrị mwepụ, mwube i nwere ike ịgbanwe maka nchekwa siri ike, maọbụ omume i nwere ike inwere iji chekwaa ekwentị gị.

Google Play Protect na-enyocha ngwa na ekwentị gị mgbe niile maka malware na omume ọjọọ ndị ọzọ, wee zitere gị ozi ma ọ bụrụ na achọpụtara nsogbu ọbụla. Gbanye Google Play Protect maka nchekwa ekwentị na data gị.

One battery cycle refers to the use (discharging) of an amount that is equal to 100% of the battery capacity. (A cycle can add up at different intervals due to discharging and charging at different battery levels, for example, using up 60% of the battery on one day, then recharging fully and using 40% the next day. Ụkpụrụ mepere emepe C2PA na-achọ ibelata ozi na-eduhie eduhie n’ịntanet site n’inye ụzọ iji nyochaa isi mmalite, akụkọ ndezi, na mbinye aka nke ngwa ndezi ọ bụla.
Nzuzo, nchekwa, na njikwa onye ọrụ bụ isi ụkpụrụ nke njimara amamihe dị elu nke Galaxy AI. Ị na-enwe ike ịchịkwa mgbe niile mgbe ejiri njimara amamihe dị elu nke Galaxy AI na otu ha si edozi data gị.
